description: Recovers the original transaction for the same authenticated buyer, authority policy, request ID, offer, sanitized scope, amount, currency, funding route, and current terms. Before funding it resumes an expired reservation; after verified funding it safely reissues scoped order access without charging again.

acquisition_channel.description: Optional allowlisted discovery source for privacy-minimized revenue attribution.

continuation_token.description: Opaque token returned with a matched offer. Include it so acknowledgement, authority, checkout, and funding remain one correlated journey.

request_id.description: Buyer-scoped idempotency key. Reuse it only when retrying this exact purchase attempt.

funding_method.description: Use auto unless the buyer client requires a specific rail. Auto selects the owner-enrolled delegated card when the authenticated agent's organization has one; otherwise it returns hosted checkout. Legacy hosted card and ACH values remain accepted as aliases.

mandate_token.description: Optional principal-issued signed single-transaction restriction. Non-delegated-card autonomous routes require it; delegated card may instead use the active agent's owner-issued standing allowlist and ceiling.

maximum_amount.description: Maximum authorized amount in minor currency units (cents); 4900 means $49.00.

payment_capabilities.description: Optional client capabilities used for adaptive routing. An active organization delegated-card enrollment takes precedence for auto.

task_summary.description: One sanitized bounded outcome. Never include credentials, tokens, payment data, personal data, confidential files, or production secrets.

name: recover_abandoned_purchase
title: Recover an expired Zinvyl purchase route
